justification: Repository-wide search found only one production caller of this class: `core/src/main/java/com/google/googlejavaformat/java/javadoc/JavadocFormatter.java:56-88`, where `JavadocFormatter` instantiates `JavadocWriter` and dispatches every token type to its write/request methods. `core/src/main/java/com/google/googlejavaformat/java/javadoc/Token.java:23-90` only mentions `JavadocWriter` in comments, not as a dependency. `JavadocWriter.java` itself depends on a small local set (`Token`, `NestingCounter`, `ImmutableSet`, and a few static helpers) and there is no evidence of broad fan-in from multiple classes, so it does not look like a dependency hub.
